svg.title: Four levels of AI in a CRM
svg.desc: AI in a CRM comes in four levels: writing help that drafts emails and sums up notes when you ask; insights that score leads and flag deals that need attention; automation that fills fields and logs activity from email and calls; and agents that run whole jobs, like lead lists and call recaps.
svg.text: Four levels of AI in a CRM
Drafts emails and sums up notes when you ask
Scores leads and flags deals that need attention
Fills fields and logs activity from email and calls
Runs whole jobs, like lead lists and call recaps
